name: redis
description: Redis with an append-only file; every acknowledged SET must survive.

text./etc/redis.conf:
port 6379
bind 127.0.0.1
dir /data/redis
save ""
appendonly yes
appendfsync always
hz 1
dynamic-hz no

workload.run:
i=$HYDO_FROM
while [ $i -lt $HYDO_TO ]; do
  r=$(timeout 2 /bin/redis-cli SET k:$i v$i 2>/dev/null)   # a 2 s client deadline
  if [ "$r" = OK ]; then echo $i >> $HYDO_ACKED; echo "$i ack" >> $HYDO_OUTCOMES
  else echo "$i unknown" >> $HYDO_OUTCOMES; fi
  i=$((i + 1))
done

invariants.msg: every SET the client saw acknowledged reads back with its value
invariants.cmd:
lost=0
for i in $(cat $HYDO_ACKED); do
  [ "$(/bin/redis-cli GET k:$i)" = "v$i" ] || { echo "key k:$i lost"; lost=1; break; }
done
[ $lost = 0 ] && echo "acked=$(wc -l < $HYDO_ACKED) all present"
[ $lost = 0 ]
